item.title: Emergency services attend road traffic collision near Waringstown
item.description: Police, Fire and Ambulance crews are currently dealing with a road traffic collision on the Banbridge Road, Waringstown. The road remains open at this time. Please follow directions from officers in attendance and approach the scene with care.
